packages_note: SkillOpt's runtime deps already in exp895/venv: openai 3.35.1, pyyaml 6.0.3, numpy 2.5.4, openpyxl 3.1.5, json_repair 0.64.1, tiktoken 0.14.0, httpx 0.28.1. azure-identity/azure-core (pyproject deps) are NOT installed: they are imported lazily only on the azure_openai backend path, which this arm never takes.

data.optimizer_sees: train only (official train 80): per step a batch of 6 train tasks x 3 trials -> up to 18 trajectories in SkillOpt minibatches of 8 (agent transcript capped at 20k chars + gold-safe scorer feedback + target system/user prompts); end of epoch >=2: slow-update and meta-skill longitudinal pairs on 20 sampled train tasks (prev vs current skill). Also the step buffer: failure patterns and rejected edits with gate score before/after (a val aggregate).
data.selects_on: val 40 (official val): SkillOpt's selection gate (gate_metric=hard, pooled mean over the 3 trial rows per task, sel_cache keyed by skill hash); champion = best_skill.md
data.aggregate_feedback_to_optimizer_from_val: the gate scores of rejected steps appear in the step buffer (upstream behaviour); no val trajectories
data.test: never loaded: SkillOpt's own test/items.json is not opened; the split's test dir is a 1-item TRAIN-id stub; eval_test=false; the official test list is read only to assert zero overlap

settings.R: shared CommonRollout counter; look-ahead step / longitudinal-pair guards (deviations D8)
